sourceSentences: Anivia launches a chunk of ice in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit and slows them for 3 seconds.
Flash Frost can be recast while the ice is in flight after its cast time, and does so automatically at maximum range.
Recast: Anivia shatters the ice, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and stunning them for a duration, as well as refreshing the slow.
Spell shield can block the effects of either the active or the recast, but not both if the former is blocked.
Anivia summons a wall of ice at the target location perpendicular to her facing, knocking all units away from it, though not through terrain. The wall lingers as impassable terrain for 5 seconds.
Player-generated terrain such as Crystallize does not block sight.
Enemies hit by Flash Frost or a fully formed Glacial Storm become Iced for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.

The damage of Frostbite is calculated once it hits. If the target's mark from being hit by Flash Frost or a fully formed Glacial Storm wears off while the projectile is traveling, the damage is not doubled.
The blizzard increases in size over 1.5 seconds. At maximum size, Glacial Storm is empowered to deal 300% damage and increase the effectiveness of its slow by 50%.
Glacial Storm is toggled off automatically if Anivia moves too far away from the blizzard or becomes unable to pay the mana cost, or is affected by any form of cast-inhibiting crowd control.
Stasis via Zhonya's Hourglass doesn't interrupt Glacial Storm.
